content.text:
I need to identify which container the 2-outlined blob forms and figure out which 3s fall inside versus outside it. The outline spans roughly rows 2-12, cols 1-12, so I'm checking each 3's coordinates against that boundary - (1,1), (1,8), (1,12) sit above the outline and stay outside, while (3,4) and (5,5) fall inside and should be removed, and (5,14) is outside and stays.

Continuing down, (6,7), (6,9), (7,5), and (8,8) all land inside the boundary and get removed, while (10,1) sits left of the outline's row-10 cells and stays outside. For (10,6) I'm judging it falls between the outline columns and counts as inside, while for row 12 I'm treating (12,2) as outside (left of the shape) but uncertain about (12,9), (12,11), and (12,14) since the bottom boundary is ambiguous — I'm leaning toward keeping them outside based on a similar case where a 2 near a gap in the outline stayed outside the shape.
